# The analysis stage dumps facts *about* a program, so it defaults to json
# rather than to the sngl source form the other stages print. It used to fail
# at these exact flags — the documented ones — twice over: --format defaulted
# to sngl, which cannot render it, and the analysis carried the whole
# *ir.Package, which json could not walk without hitting a cycle.

sngl dump --stage analysis --lang js --platform html main.sngl
stdout '"ModelFields"'
stdout '"count": true'
stdout '"ComputedDeps"'
stdout '"UsedComponents"'

# (The "Pkg" keys further down are ir.Component.Pkg, the URI string a
# declaration came from — not the package pointer that used to be here. The
# structural guard for that is TestCommonAnalysisHoldsNoIRPackage.)

# Helpers and Styles are what codegen accumulates while it emits, not what
# analysis derived. They live on Emission and are absent here.
! stdout '"Helpers"'
! stdout '"Styles"'

# An explicit --format is still obeyed, and spew renders the same facts.
sngl dump --stage analysis --format spew --lang js --platform html main.sngl
stdout 'ModelFields'

# Asking for the source form is an error that names the formats that work,
# rather than the bare "unable to format" it used to be.
! sngl dump --stage analysis --format sngl --lang js --platform html main.sngl
stderr 'cannot render \*codegen.CommonAnalysis as sngl source'
stderr 'try --format json or --format spew'

# The default is per-stage, not global: every other stage still prints sngl.
sngl dump --stage checked main.sngl
stdout 'component main'

-- main.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

var count = 0

component main node {
    text(value="hello")
    button(text="go", @click { count = count + 1 })
}

window {
    main
}
